title: terminal writer error when pytest is called with pytest.main(pytest_args, plugins=[pytest_finish_plugin(), pytest_start_plugin()])

labels.name: type: bug
labels.description: problem that needs to be addressed

labels.name: topic: reporting
labels.description: related to terminal output and user-facing messages and errors

terminal writer exception, calling pytest as `pytest.main(pytest_args, plugins=[pytest_finish_plugin(), pytest_start_plugin()])`

relevant pytest pip list:
```
pytest                             6.0.1                
pytest-html                        2.1.1                
pytest-instafail                   0.4.1.post0          
pytest-lazy-fixture                0.6.3

pytest-tldr                        0.2.1                
python-key-path-mapping            1.1.0                
pytoolkit                          0.7.0                
PyYAML                             5.3.1                
```

system host: macOSx , catalina
